summary: Corrected the StateSnapshot investigation's disposition to explained, and converted this run's one concrete observation into retained evidence: a fixed experiment (draft/assurance_generated_test.go, package raft) that drives the unexported readOnly confirmation path with ack values the live instance's heartbeatCtx never emitted, and compares two outcomes - a slice-bounds panic in maybeAdvance when the quorum ack position exceeds the outstanding request count, and confirmation of reads via a single forged ack plus the leader's self-ack. The accompanying interpretation stays a source account with the defect claim refuted (no in-model producer supplies such a Context; this is out-of-contract robustness), does not cite parsed indices since the experiment has no receipt yet, and the harness is supplied as the primary harness only (no files override). Earlier submissions for the read-index queue and snapshot-repair threads remain unchanged.
